title: Audit record
description: One record per agent answer, per proposal the acting agent drafts and per human decision on a proposal, in one log the agent operator and the auditor read. A record holds in clear only what tells no reader any data value: who, when, which data, code, metric versions, query text and warehouse job; it holds a seal (agent/audit.py) in place of every value a reader of the log may not see (the question, query parameters, each query's result, the answer, a proposal's request, inputs and draft). The salt and value of each seal are kept outside the log, keyed by the record's position. Records form one hash chain: `prev` is the previous record's `digest`, `digest` the SHA-256 of the record's RFC 8785 canonical form without `digest`.

seq.description: The record's position in the log, from 0, with no gap; the key its sealed values are kept under.

prev.description: The `digest` of the record at position seq - 1; sixty-four zeros for the first record.

digest.description: SHA-256 of the record's RFC 8785 canonical form, every field but this one.

at.description: When the answer was given, the proposal drafted or the decision taken.

sealed.description: A seal: SHA-256 of the RFC 8785 form of [salt, value], the salt random and kept with the value outside the log.

persona.description: A persona id of access/personas.yaml; a test checks it against the catalogue.

asker.description: The human persona who asked, the session they asked in and the turn of that session.

release.description: The code the answer or proposal ran on: the commit of this repository, which holds the prompt, the tools, the models, the metric definitions and the catalogues.

model.description: The model that wrote the text, as its provider names it, and every setting sent with the call; absent when no model wrote it.

data.description: The data the answer was read from: the warehouse build queried and every landed file it was built from, with when each landed, which is the answer's freshness.

id.description: The build's run identifier, dbt's invocation id.

name.description: A source of ingest/sources.yaml, the landed file's name.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the landed file's bytes.

metric.description: A MetricFlow metric the answer cites and the version of its definition it was answered at.

run.description: One warehouse job: the query as sent, the identity it ran as, the engine and job reference, and the seal of its result.

text.description: The SQL exactly as sent; every value taken from the question or from a result is bound as a parameter, never written into it.

parameters.description: The seal of the bound parameters, an object of name to value; absent when the query binds none.

as.description: The persona whose identity the warehouse ran the job as.

job.description: The warehouse's reference to the job: a BigQuery job's project, location and id, or the local engine's run id.

result.description: The seal of the result as {columns: [name, ...], rows: [[cell, ...], ...]}, in the order returned, each cell the text the engine casts it to, or null.

answer.description: An answer to one question: answered, with at least one warehouse run and one metric, or abstained, when no metric or verified query covers the question.

question.description: The seal of the question as asked.

answer.description: The seal of the answer text as given.

proposal.description: An entry the acting agent drafted at a human's request, before any decision on it.

agent.description: The agent persona that drafted the entry.

request.description: The seal of the request as made.

inputs.description: The seal of the documents the draft was made from.

draft.description: The seal of the drafted entry as shown to the approver.

approval.description: A human decision on one proposal: what they saw is sealed under the draft's salt, so its seal equals the proposal's draft exactly when they saw that draft.

proposal.description: The proposal's record, by position and digest.

posting.description: The ERP's reference to the posted entry.
